Name: Azure Lake
Author: aldrichosaurusrex30
Description:
[A/N] Hello everyone! This is my third farm map called Azure Lake. I made this mod with a cottagecore aesthetics in mind, but I didn't realize it was gonna be this big of a farm plot. Also, my entry for the 10th anniversary of Stardew Valley! Thank you, Eric Barone, aka Concerned Ape (And Team!) for this wonderful game!

Known Issues: 
~ Greenhouse dirt tiles when moving it. (As always XD)

Side Notes:
~Standard map is the default farm map to replace. Change it when starting a new save on the GMCM menu.
~Everything is tillable.
~You can get mountain fish in all of the waters.
~No Secret Locations this time.

Please Endorse my mod so I can win a PIN XD
